name: Homemade Trail Mix
prep_steps: Combine all ingredients in a small container.
Portion into individual servings for grab-and-go snacking.
Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Apple Slices with Almond Butter
prep_steps: Slice the apple into wedges.
Serve with almond butter for dipping.
Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired.

name: Yogurt and Granola Cup
prep_steps: Spoon yogurt into a cup or small bowl.
Top with granola and berries.
Drizzle with honey.

name: Steamed Edamame with Sea Salt
ingredients: 1 cup frozen edamame in the shell
prep_steps: Steam or microwave edamame according to package directions (usually 3-5 minutes).
Drain and sprinkle with sea salt.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top if desired.
Eat by squeezing the beans out of the pods.

name: Hummus with Veggie Sticks
prep_steps: Wash and cut vegetables into sticks and rounds.
Place hummus in a small bowl or container.
Arrange vegetables around the hummus for dipping.

name: No-Bake Energy Bites
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats (certified gluten-free if needed)
1/2 cup peanut butter or almond butter
prep_steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until well combined.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes to make the mixture easier to handle.
Roll into 1-inch balls (makes about 15-18 bites).
Store in the refrigerator for up to one week.

name: Sardines on Whole Grain Crackers
ingredients: 1 can sardines in olive oil, drained
prep_steps: Arrange crackers on a plate.
Top each with sardines.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top.
Garnish with herbs and red onion if desired.
